decisions.reason: The regional electricity tariff calculator has its own web page, embodies sunk development effort, and fits the announced central-platform strategy, so management continues to stand behind it.

The multi-model energy tariff calculator line represents a sizeable investment and a visible commitment to customers, and its weak web presence can still be read as a temporary issue, so persistence prevails.
The area definition tool is presented on its own page and supports the remaining location-based offerings, but losing A and B weakens its rationale somewhat, so management still keeps it.

The site-specific comparison line is closest to the withdrawn gas comparison and has only modest visibility, yet the investment in several models and its core fit lead management to retain it for now.
